metadata.title: The Relay — Stand-In Calibration and Operational Limit Specifications
metadata.phase: Phase 4: Controllable & Calibrated Stand-In Model Service
metadata.empirical_parity_claim: NONE (Zero parity claims fabricated; empirical residuals unavailable without live benchmark data)

provenance_legend.Documented Rate Limit: Verified against official published provider documentation (console.groq.com/settings/limits).
provenance_legend.System Architecture Parameter: Architectural design parameter derived from capacity engineering (e.g., Little's Law L = lambda * W).
provenance_legend.Provisional Baseline: Configured baseline parameter pending empirical calibration in authorized live benchmark runs.
provenance_legend.Synthetic Specification: Controllable simulation parameter or test fixture matching official schema and error formats.
provenance_legend.Unverified Empirical Measurement: Metric not empirically verified through real telemetry in this workspace.

base_ttft_ms.description: Baseline Time-to-First-Token prefill latency under zero load.
base_ttft_ms.validation_status: Provisional; derived from published Llama 3.1 8B instant prefill averages on hosted hardware.
base_ttft_ms.measurement_method: Configured baseline; empirical fitting deferred to live benchmark run.

prompt_token_slope.description: Prefill latency scaling factor per prompt token.
prompt_token_slope.validation_status: Provisional; accounts for linear token embedding/attention prefill duration.

noise_sigma_ms.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian TTFT noise for synthetic latency variance.
noise_sigma_ms.validation_status: Synthetic; active when inject_delay=True and random_seed is set.

slow_ttft_ms.description: Forced TTFT stall duration for Heading 4 tail latency diagnosis and slow-request attribution.

itl_ms.validation_status: Derived from Groq published speed benchmarks for llama-3.1-8b-instant (200-280 tok/s).
itl_ms.measurement_method: Analytical conversion from published throughput: 1000 ms / 222 tokens ≈ 4.5 ms/tok.

slow_tpot_ms.description: Forced slow decode generation delay for post-TTFT tail latency diagnosis.

chunk_size.description: Number of tokens per Server-Sent Event (SSE) streaming delta chunk.
chunk_size.validation_status: Matches Groq SSE chunk delivery granularity.

concurrency_knee.description: Active in-flight request threshold before concurrency degradation begins.

concurrency_slope.description: Fractional latency degradation multiplier per active request exceeding concurrency knee.
concurrency_slope.measurement_method: Configured degradation factor: multiplier = 1.0 + slope * max(0, C - knee).

in_flight_concurrency_cap.description: Theoretical gateway capacity ceiling derived from Little's Law.
in_flight_concurrency_cap.validation_status: Unverified empirical measurement; derived via Little's Law: L = lambda * W = (30/60) * 16 = 8.

rate_limit_rpm.description: Groq free-tier sliding window requests per minute limit.

rate_limit_tpm.description: Groq free-tier rolling window tokens per minute limit.

residuals_evaluation.explanation: Phase 3 and Phase 4 executed strictly offline with 0 live API calls to preserve free-tier quota. Empirical residuals (|y_real - y_standin|) cannot be computed without measured real-service data. No empirical parity claims (<10% match) are fabricated.

differences_from_real_service.real_groq: Unpredictable tail latency spikes and cold-start queueing delays caused by other tenants sharing the Groq LPU cluster.
differences_from_real_service.standin: Deterministic latency governed strictly by local in-flight concurrency tracking and configured Gaussian noise.

differences_from_real_service.real_groq: Proprietary continuous token replenishment and leaky bucket pacing that may reject micro-bursts even when 60s volume appears within budget.
differences_from_real_service.standin: Explicit sliding-window timestamp tracker for RPM and TPM with predictable retry-after calculation.

differences_from_real_service.real_groq: Autoregressive neural generation on custom Tensor Streaming Processor / LPU hardware executing billions of matrix multiplications.
differences_from_real_service.standin: Deterministic grounded response synthesis from retrieved XML <passage> tags and arXiv citation formatting.
